catalog.description: Set "tc.card/2.1" when the card has a 2.1 block (rank, rating, scale, confirm, imageChoice, matrix, slots, poll, buttons, diagram, embed, stack, row, compare, tabs, questionnaire). Absent = tc.card/2.0.

rev.description: 1 on post (the server sets it). Every patch raises it; a patch names the rev it changes.

intent.description: ask: people must answer. info: something to read (numbers, a comparison), no status band. working: work people follow while it runs. done: a result.

status.description: The band of a working card: executing or failed. Absent: the band follows intent.

summary.description: One plain sentence under the title.

fallback.description: The whole card as plain text, for notifications, search and old clients.

id.description: The ask round, default "a1". A new id opens a new round of answers.

from.description: Who may answer: member ids, "requester" (the person your run works for) or "owners".

blocking.description: The topic waits for the answer. Default: true when intent is ask.

expiresAt.description: Milliseconds since 1970; after it the ask takes no answer.

promise.description: What you promise until the answer, shown with the question.

record.description: true: the answer is kept as a decision of the group.

typeToConfirm.description: The answerer types this text before the submit action is enabled.

irreversible.description: For what cannot be undone: the card names the action, its target and the consequence before the answer is sent.

ask.description: Who is asked. Without it nobody is asked and the topic does not wait, whatever the intent.

blocks.description: The content, top to bottom. Containers (stack, row, tabs, compare, questionnaire, group with children) name other blocks of this list by id.

kind.description: submit (default), reject (the answer no) and cancel are answers; submit and reject carry the values of `inputs`. link opens `target`. press is a live event, never an answer.

target.description: Where a link action goes; only link actions have one.

confirm.description: The client asks this before it sends the answer.

inputs.description: submit and reject: the ids of the input blocks whose values go with the answer.

role.description: "approve" marks the action that approves a reviewed change (a diff, a pull request).

actions.description: The buttons under the card, at most 10 and at most one with style primary.

data.description: Your own state for this card, at most 16 KiB; people never see it.

rows.description: One list of strings per row, one cell per column. Numbers are written as strings.

rowKeys.description: One stable key per row, used by table.rowSelect and by quotes; default the row index.

select.description: Makes the table an input: the answer is the chosen row key or keys.

sortable.description: People may sort by a column; you get table.sort only when `events` lists it.

table.description: A table; with `select` it is an input.

status.description: todo, in_progress, done, failed or skipped.

list.description: A list of lines, each with an optional state.

image.description: A picture of the group's files.

link.description: A link to a web page, a topic or a 产出.

detail.description: A sentence under the option's label.

recommended.description: true on the option you would pick.

default.description: The option ids chosen at first.

allowOther.description: Adds a choice with free text.

decision.description: A choice: one option, or several with `multiple`.

kind.description: text, textarea, number, select, date, switch, chips or slider.

options.description: The choices of select and chips.

input.description: One value from a person: text, a number, a date, a switch, a choice.

editable.description: false shows the text without editing.

draft.description: A text people may edit before they submit it.

runId.description: Shows that run's live plan instead of `items`.

items.description: The steps, in order: {text, state}. state is done, current, waiting (for a person) or pending. Without items the block shows nothing.

plan.description: A list of steps with their state.

value.description: A number; the unit goes in `unit`.

delta.description: The change against the last value, in the same unit.

better.description: Which direction of `delta` is good: up or down.

metric.description: One number with its label and its change.

x.description: The label of each point on the x axis.

series.description: 1 to 5 series; each `values` has one number per label of `x`.

summary.description: One sentence that says what the chart shows.

chart.description: A line, bar or area chart, or a sparkline.

state.description: pass, fail or info. On a done card a pass without fileId, url, artifact or recording is shown as your claim, not as passed.

fileId.description: A file that shows it (a screenshot, a log).

url.description: A web page that shows it.

artifact.description: The 产出 version that shows it: {artifactId, version}.

tests.description: Test counts. On a done card they come from the run's log, not from you.

recording.description: A screen recording of the group's files.

evidence.description: One line of proof: what was checked and what shows it.

target.description: {kind: pr, url}, {kind: artifact, artifactId, version?}, {kind: topic, groupId, topicId}, {kind: member, memberId} or {kind: url, url}.

ref.description: A reference people can open: a pull request, a 产出, a topic, a member or a web page.

cut.description: A line after the first `after` items.

rankTop.description: Only the first n items are the answer.

labels.description: Words for some values, keys "1" to "5".

ends.description: The words at the two ends.

scale.description: A number on a scale from `min` to `max`.

confirm.description: A yes or no question; one tap is the answer.

recommended.description: true on the option you would pick.

matrix.description: One choice per row from the same columns.

tz.description: The IANA time zone the slots are shown in.

voters.description: "group" or a list of member ids.

public.description: Who voted for what is shown.

changeable.description: A voter may change the vote until it closes.

confirm.description: The client asks this before it sends the press.

buttons.description: 1 to 3 inline buttons. They send button.press (list it in `events`) and never answer an ask.

source.description: Mermaid that starts with flowchart, graph, sequenceDiagram, stateDiagram, stateDiagram-v2, classDiagram, erDiagram, gantt or timeline. No click, href, callback, call, %%{ directives, front matter or HTML.

alt.description: What the diagram shows, for readers who cannot see it.

diagram.description: A diagram drawn from Mermaid source.

artifactId.description: A 产出 of the same group.

embed.description: A 产出 page shown live inside the card.

children.description: The ids of its blocks (2.1). Give either `children` or `blocks`.

group.description: A titled section that can fold.

weights.description: Relative widths 1 to 3, one per child.

recommended.description: true on the option you would pick.

children.description: The ids of the blocks shown in the option.

note.description: A text note that goes with the pick.

compare.description: 2 to 4 options side by side; picking one is the answer.

children.description: The ids of the tab's blocks.

tabs.description: 2 to 5 tabs, each with its blocks.

children.description: The ids of its input blocks.

anonymous.description: You get the answers as totals only.

questionnaire.description: 2 to 5 questions answered together with one button.

emitBy.description: Who may send this block's live events: ask (who is asked), requester, members, owners or {memberIds}. Default: who is asked, for the blocks an open question is answered with; else every member.

events.description: The live events this block sends you. A block sends only the events listed here; each block type has its own names (`chat-run --help`, Interaction).

fallbackText.description: Plain text for clients that do not know this block type. Required on rank, rating, scale, confirm, imageChoice, matrix, slots, poll, buttons, diagram, embed, compare and questionnaire.

deliver.description: Input blocks. immediate: one tap is the answer (single choice, confirm, compare, rating, scale, single-line input). onSubmit: the value goes with a submit action.

id.description: Unique in the card: 1..64 of A-Za-z0-9_.:- (not root, not starting with $).

emphasis.description: high: at most 2 blocks of a card. low: shown quieter.
